Belarusian

[edit]
Belarusian Wikipedia has an article on:
немка
Wikipedia be

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈnʲemka]

Noun

[edit]

не́мка • (njémka) f pers (genitive не́мкі, nominative plural не́мкі, genitive plural не́мак, male equivalent не́мец)

  1. a German (female)
    яна́ не́мка ― janá njémka ― she is a German

Russian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • нѣ́мка (ně́mka) — pre-1918 spelling

Etymology

[edit]

не́м(ец) (ném(ec)) +‎ -ка (-ka)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [ˈnʲemkə]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

не́мка • (némka) f anim (genitive не́мки, nominative plural не́мки, genitive plural не́мок, male equivalent не́мец, diminutive не́мочка)

  1. female equivalent of не́мец (némec): German woman or girl
  2. female teacher of German language
